Plot societies through time, one point per society

Source: R/plot_society_time.R
plot_society_time.Rd

Plots each society along the x axis at its D-PLACE `main_focal_year` – the (ethnographic) year the society's coded data mainly reflects (see [dplace_societies]). Points are jittered vertically by default (the y axis carries no meaning either way) purely so societies sharing a focal year don't sit exactly on top of each other. Optionally coloured by any column in `data`, e.g. `region` or `lang_family`, or – via the variable-aware [plot_variable_time()] – a D-PLACE variable's coded value.

Usage

plot_society_time(
  data,
  color = NULL,
  jitter = TRUE,
  jitter_seed = 42,
  label = FALSE,
  point_size = 2
)

Arguments

data

Either a character vector of D-PLACE society IDs, or a data frame/tibble. If it doesn't already have a `main_focal_year` column, it must have a `soc_id` column, which is used to look it up via [get_society_meta()]. Rows with an unknown focal year are dropped with a warning.

color

Optional; the name of a column in `data` to map to point colour (e.g. `"region"`, `"lang_family"`, or a variable's value). Left plain (a single colour) if omitted.

jitter

Logical; if `TRUE` (the default), points are jittered vertically so societies sharing a focal year remain distinguishable. Set `FALSE` to plot them exactly on the axis line instead.

jitter_seed

A random seed used only for the vertical jitter, so repeated calls on the same data produce the same layout. Default `42`; change it for a different (but still reproducible) layout.

label

Logical; if `TRUE`, label each point with its `soc_id` (only if `data` has one). Default `FALSE`.

point_size

Point size, passed to `ggplot2::geom_point()`. Default `2`.

Value

A `ggplot` object; print it to display, or add further `ggplot2` layers/theming to customize it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_society_time(c("B72", "B73", "B79"))
plot_society_time(dp_societies(region = "Southern Africa"), color = "lang_family")
} # }
